protocol.fit: OLS(log R, log S_eta), two-sided 95% Student-t interval; envelope is conservatively interpreted with the flux-path spread
protocol.resolution_rule: at least 8 cells per nominal delta_SP/L=S_eta^-1/2 and measured central-sheet |Jz| FWHM at least 4 cells
protocol.eligibility: full flux window, resolved, finite rate and zero detected secondary A_z extrema at prominence 0.005 in |x|=[0.04,0.22]
protocol.decision: reject band only if the complete 95% interval is disjoint from [-0.60,-0.40]; otherwise inconclusive; unresolved or plasmoid cases are excluded/censored
